gaps.explanation: Statement p5-6 (Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, GAAP) total revenues 40,609,432 = General 16,495,284 + Streets Engineering 4,644,937 + Sales Tax 7,014,715 + 1/2 Cent Sales Tax 6,158,350 + ARP Act 769,852 + Other Governmental Funds 5,526,294. detail = budget-basis schedules p13-17: General 16,014,808 + Streets/Engineering 4,657,735 + Sales Tax 7,030,245 (printed lines; printed total 7,031,296) + 1/2 Sales Tax 3,157,980 + ARP 35,938 = 30,896,706. (1) Missing: the Other Governmental Funds column (p6) has no schedule in the trim: Property taxes 62,946 + Fees, taxes, permits and licenses 262,683 + Sales tax 425,592 + Gaming tax 253,999 + Charges for services 853,833 + Donations 16,798 + Grants 288,104 + Investment earnings 551,153 + Miscellaneous 2,811,186 = 5,526,294 (added). (2) Different basis, remaining 4,186,432 = budget-basis actuals vs GAAP per fund: General 16,495,284 - 16,014,808 = +480,476; Streets 4,644,937 - 4,657,735 = -12,798; Sales Tax 7,014,715 - 7,030,245 = -15,530; 1/2 Cent 6,158,350 - 3,157,980 = +3,000,370 (GAAP Grants 3,000,000 not on the budget schedule p16; sales tax 3,032,095 vs 3,031,725); ARP 769,852 - 35,938 = +733,914 (GAAP Grants 733,914 not on the budget schedule p17). 30,896,706 + 5,526,294 + 4,186,432 = 40,609,432.

gaps.explanation: Statement p5-6 Transfers in 15,665,259 = General 12,714,507 + Streets 1,055,360 + Sales Tax 506,755 + Other Governmental Funds 1,388,637. detail has General 'Transfers in (out), net' 12,204,864 (p13 budget schedule, index 15) + Streets 1,055,360 (index 23) = 13,260,224. (1) Other Governmental Funds Transfers in 1,388,637 (p6) missing. (2) The budget schedules print transfers only net per fund (General net 12,204,864 on the budget basis; GAAP net p5 = 12,714,507 - 986,755 = 11,727,752; Sales Tax net -8,326,580 = 506,755 - 8,833,335), so the gross transfers in of General and Sales Tax are not in detail. Fix: remove the General net line (index 15) and add the statement's gross General Transfers in 12,714,507 and Sales Tax Transfers in 506,755 (the matching gross transfers out and removal of the Sales Tax net line are under transfers_out). Note the General budget-basis net 12,204,864 differs from the GAAP net 11,727,752 by 477,112; after the fix detail follows the GAAP statement. Check: 13,260,224 - 12,204,864 + 12,714,507 + 506,755 + 1,388,637 = 15,665,259 (exact).

gaps.explanation: Statement p5-6 Transfers out (11,613,232) = General (986,755) + Sales Tax (8,833,335) + ARP Act (883,468) + Other Governmental Funds (909,674). detail has Sales Tax 'Transfers in (out), net' -8,326,580 (p15, index 26) + ARP -883,468 (p17, index 33) = 9,210,048. (1) Other Governmental Funds Transfers out (909,674) (p6) missing. (2) General transfers out (986,755) are netted inside the General budget-schedule net line (removed under transfers_in) and the Sales Tax net -8,326,580 = in 506,755 - out 8,833,335. Fix: remove the Sales Tax net line (index 26) and add the gross General Transfers out -986,755 and Sales Tax Transfers out -8,833,335 from p5, plus Other Governmental Funds -909,674. Check: 9,210,048 - 8,326,580 + 986,755 + 8,833,335 + 909,674 = 11,613,232 (exact).
